children: Biom announced it will change its corporate name to Tessera Defense and Homeland Security and begin trading under ticker HLSQ on Sept 11, 2026.
Board approved name change to Tessera Defense and Homeland Security, effective 12:01 a.m. ET on September 11, 2026.
Common stock will trade on NYSE American under new ticker symbol HLSQ starting at market open on September 11, 2026.
One-for-ten reverse stock split expected effective 12:01 a.m. ET on September 9, 2026; CUSIP 09090D 608 will remain assigned.
Name change does not affect stockholder rights; no action or certificate exchange required by stockholders.
Change reflects company transformation into a defense and homeland security technology group built via recent acquisitions.
